allow: PowerShell($vars = Get-ChildItem env: | Where-Object { $_.Name -match 'GH_TOKEN|GITHUB_TOKEN|GITHUB|TOKEN' }; $vars | ForEach-Object { Write-Output \("{0} = {1}" -f $_.Name, \($_.Value.Substring\(0,[Math]::Min\(6,$_.Value.Length\)\) + "..."\)\) }; Write-Output "---"; git config --get credential.helper)
Bash(python -c "import sys,json; d=json.load\(sys.stdin\); [print\(f\\"#{i['number']} [{'PR' if 'pull_request' in i else 'issue'}] {i['title']}\\"\) for i in d]")
Bash(python -c "import sys,json; d=json.load\(sys.stdin\); [print\(f\\"#{p['number']} {p['head']['ref']} -> {p['base']['ref']} | {p['title']}\\"\) for p in d]")
Bash(python -c "import sys,json; d=json.load\(sys.stdin\); [print\(f\\"--- {r['user']['login']} [{r['state']}] \({r.get\('submitted_at'\)}\) ---\\n{r.get\('body'\)}\\n\\"\) for r in d]")
